evidence.curator_note: The FAST branch, drawn as a single arrow labelled 'fast' from the 2-hexanone molecular ion (the page numbers its carbons 1-6 and draws '+.' on the carbonyl oxygen) to 'CH3.' -- explicitly labelled '1' -- plus the acylium, drawn as O≡C(+)-CH2CH2CH2CH3. Ordinary radical-site alpha cleavage of the C1-C2 bond. This is the normal 70 eV channel: the prose above the scheme states 'at 70 eV the 2-hexanone ion loses predominantly the C-1 methyl to give the stable acyl ion C4H9CO+', which is why this record alone carries 70 eV EI conditions while the slow route (IMS9-EQ9.27b/c) is metastable. *** Equation 9.27 draws NO CURVED ARROWS AT ALL -- not one, anywhere on the page. *** Every transformation is conveyed by a reaction-type label ('fast', 'slow', rH, rC) plus the changed structure. Book draws 0 arc(s) for this step and ALL of its electron moves are therefore curator-supplied. This is still a mechanism and not a bare result (contrast eq 9.5, which is in NON_MECHANISM_EQS): the page prints six successive INTERMEDIATE structures with explicit, individually localised charge and radical sites, and each consecutive pair differs by exactly one well-defined change, so the flow is recoverable without inventing connectivity. The book prints its OWN carbon numbers 1-6 on every structure, and this record reuses them as atom maps so the mapping can be checked against the page by eye. That numbering is the whole point of the equation: it is what distinguishes the fast route (which expels the C-1 methyl) from the slow one (which expels C-4 or C-6 after skeletal scrambling). The three moves are the canonical radical-site triple: <1> the oxygen odd electron into the forming C-O pi bond, <2> one electron of the breaking C1-C2 sigma bond into that same bond -- raising C2-O7 from double to TRIPLE, the acylium the page draws as O≡C+ -- and <3> the other C1-C2 electron leaving with the methyl radical. MEASUREMENTS (convention F): this equation prints NO m/z value and no percentage anywhere -- not on the molecular ion, not on any intermediate, not on any product. Every mass in this record is CURATOR-COMPUTED from the instantiated structures. The ions are nevertheless marked detected=true with status 'proposed', following the corpus precedent of IMS8-EQ8.60 / IMS8-EQ8.81a/b, because the running prose reports them as observed species ('the 2-hexanone ion loses predominantly the C-1 methyl to give the stable acyl ion C4H9CO+'; 'protonated pentenone'). No relative_intensity is recorded: the only number on the page is the prose '<3%', which is an UPPER BOUND on a metastable branching ratio, not a 70 eV EI abundance.
